vectors.invariant: Exact contract byte changes do not reuse a prior artifact identity.
vectors.failure_signal: Old identity remains trusted after byte change.

vectors.invariant: Display aliases cannot repair a missing operation identity.
vectors.failure_signal: Alias lookup silently chooses an operation.

vectors.invariant: Nested services remain independently scoped.
vectors.failure_signal: One adapter selection hides a sibling service.

vectors.invariant: Overlapping roots require explicit ownership or ambiguity.
vectors.failure_signal: Files are silently assigned to one project.

vectors.invariant: Computed prefixes are not converted into invented literal paths.
vectors.failure_signal: A guessed literal path is emitted as verified.

vectors.invariant: A multi-mounted router may produce distinct absolute paths.
vectors.failure_signal: Only one mount survives.

vectors.invariant: Lossy schema conversion blocks capabilities that require lost information.
vectors.failure_signal: Generation proceeds without a loss diagnostic.

vectors.invariant: Remote references are not fetched without an approved immutable bundle.
vectors.failure_signal: Analysis performs unapproved network resolution.

vectors.invariant: Wrong-role and cross-tenant requests are not accepted as authorized evidence.
vectors.failure_signal: Authorization assertion passes for an unauthorized request.

vectors.invariant: Declared security and runtime enforcement remain distinct claims.
vectors.failure_signal: A declaration alone is marked enforced.

vectors.invariant: Composite foreign-key column order is preserved.
vectors.failure_signal: Local and referenced columns are flattened or cross-multiplied.

vectors.invariant: Entity/table name similarity alone cannot create a fetch binding.
vectors.failure_signal: An implicit binding enables fetch or codegen.

vectors.invariant: Parser, resolver, policy and file-list changes invalidate dependent cache entries.
vectors.failure_signal: A stale artifact is served as current.

vectors.invariant: Deleted and newly-added files participate in invalidation.
vectors.failure_signal: Incremental scan ignores a file-list change.

vectors.invariant: Evidence from one run or attempt cannot be replayed into another.
vectors.failure_signal: Nonce or scope mismatch is accepted.

vectors.invariant: Original-oracle failure blocks comparison instead of producing pass.
vectors.failure_signal: Candidate is passed while baseline failed.

vectors.invariant: Nearby input and movement declarations do not prove causality.
vectors.failure_signal: A behavior edge is invented from names or proximity.

vectors.invariant: A candidate observation bridge cannot self-certify behavior.
vectors.failure_signal: Candidate-reported pass is accepted without an independent probe.

vectors.invariant: Static analysis does not execute target install hooks or initializers.
vectors.failure_signal: Target-controlled code executes in static mode.

vectors.invariant: Symlink and path traversal cannot escape approved roots.
vectors.failure_signal: Read or write reaches outside the allowed root.

vectors.invariant: Hand-edited generated files require an expected-old-hash match before overwrite.
vectors.failure_signal: A user-modified file is silently replaced.

vectors.invariant: Authorization stubs stay fail-closed until implemented.
vectors.failure_signal: Generated default grants access.

vectors.invariant: A green check from an older head cannot approve a new head.
vectors.failure_signal: Release reuses stale CI status.

vectors.invariant: Unknown contract majors or revoked adapters do not execute.
vectors.failure_signal: Unsupported or revoked artifacts are run.
